pages.text: Take a Red Ant down and step into wall-to-wall ore: every OreSpawn vein runs richer here, alongside ruby blocks, dense lapis, and boosted diamond, emerald and gold.$(p)Better yet, our pack now pumps other mods' ores into this stone too, so one world holds every resource. Consider it the pack's official quarry.

pages.title: Mind the Locals
pages.text: Mineshafts and strongholds thread the depths, and not everything buried is ore. Mob-filled spawn blocks and the odd Basilisk Maze break up the profit.$(p)Plan your Red Ant home. Or bring a Miner's Dream, and no, we will not spoil what that one does.
